preconditions.description: The length of the string s must be between 2 and 300,000.
The length of the string s must match the given integer n.
All characters in the string s must be lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: If no suitable substring can be reversed to make the string lexicographically smaller, output 'NO'.
If a suitable substring can be reversed, output 'YES' followed by two indices l and r.
The indices l and r must satisfy 1 <= l < r <= n.
